newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's Nov fishmeal output up 70 pct vs yr ago.
newsitem.headline: Peru's Nov fishmeal output up 70 pct vs yr ago.

text.p: Peru produced 307,800 tonnes of fishmeal in November, up 70 percent from the same month last year, the government said Thursday.
A Fisheries' Ministry report added that fishmeal production in the first eleven months of the year was 1.569 million tonnes, down 4.3 percent compared with the same period last year.
Exports for the first eleven months, however, were up 14.3 percent to $706.85 million, compared with the same period the year before.
The ministry did give export figures for November.
Officials have said the country's fishmeal production has fallen due to seasonal fishing bans and climatic factors while higher world prices have brought the overall hike in the value of exports.
Fishmeal, Peru's most important fishing product, accounted for 80 percent of Peru's total processing of 385,800 tonnes of fish and other sea products in November, the ministry report said.
